en: Black‑and‑white image showing a large street procession watched by dense crowds on both sides of a cobblestone street. Participants wear historical or religious-style robes and carry banners or a long cloth canopy. The buildings along the right side have tall, arched windows with shutters, and many onlookers lean out from upper-floor windows. The scene appears European and early 20th century.
